scenario_description:
Objective: Finish same-morning checkout and loading of cleanup kits before Riverside field crews leave the hub.
Emerging Need: The active checkout has begun, with totes already on the cart, but the locked equipment cabinet has latched shut and stopped access to the remaining gear.
Decision Context: The loading window is short, the public desk cannot release the override key, and hub records identify the proper staff-key escalation route.
Consequence: Promptly clearing the lockout could keep the started checkout useful for the cleanup; after crews depart, unlocking the cabinet no longer helps that run.

parameter.title: Riverside cleanup kit loading
parameter.description: Check out and load hub cleanup kits from the north tool closet before Riverside field crews depart at 09:40.

parameter.content: I’m by the north closet cart. The checkout sheet is open, two vest totes are already on the cart, and you’re at the cabinet now for the grabbers and cones.

parameter.subject: North closet keypad hard lockout
parameter.body: The north tool-closet keypad entered hard lockout at 09:01 after low-voltage errors. The cabinet remains latched until a staff-key override is used. The service ticket ETA is after noon, and the public desk does not hold the override key.

parameter.content: The cart is stuck half-loaded: vest totes are out, but the cabinet latch still will not release for grabbers or cones. Volunteers start arriving at 09:25 and the Riverside group leaves at 09:40.
The Riverside crews just left with only the vest totes. I left the checkout sheet on the cart and the locked cabinet is still holding the grabbers and cones.
